jobs1:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent raster sprite atlas for an English learning app.
INPUT REFERENCES: image 1 is the approved character STYLE DIRECTION only; image 2 is the user's geometric cartoon reference, STYLE ONLY. Invent entirely NEW adult characters, never reuse old app characters.
STYLE: Bold geometric Duolingo-like 2D cut-paper graphics. Varied ADULT angular and soft-rectangular heads, conspicuous noses, strong black eyebrows, small white eyes with black pupils, expressive mouth shapes. Varied adult body silhouettes: tall lanky, broad barrel, pear-shaped, slim and muscular. Head/body ratio generally 1:3 or 1:3.5; avoid babies and toddlers. Sharp memorable hair silhouettes. Simple block forearms and rounded hands, correct connected joints. Saturated palette teal, magenta, navy, orange, yellow, cream and varied natural skin tones.
FLATNESS IS MANDATORY: every contiguous material shape is one UNIFORM solid color, including face, neck, hands, hair and clothes. Remove the style direction's neck-shadow triangles, cheek side-plane lighting and any gradient. A darker nose may be a distinct single-color nose shape. NO lighting, shadows of any kind, contact shadows, floor shadows, highlights, modeled volume, gradients, texture, folds, hair shine, outline strokes or 3D.
LAYOUT: exactly FOUR COLUMNS by SEVEN ROWS: 28 separate square scene cells on a tall transparent canvas, generous empty transparent gutters. Four native successive action poses of the same adult character per row. Repeat exact character identity, head/body size, clothes and base position in all four columns. Safe margins around whole complete figures including feet, hair, props and the supporting people. Each entire scene stays within its seventh of canvas and its quarter of width. No labels, lettering, words, grid lines, panels, decorative background, watermark or floor planes. Only minimal necessary task props.
ANATOMY AND ANIMATION: four genuinely DISTINCT connected hand/forearm phases of one understandable task. Heads stable, limb lengths stable, exact two arms per person, wrists touch hands, sleeves touch arms. A held object ALWAYS physically touches its holding palm or fingers, no floating or detached objects. Stable stationary props. Do not replace real arm poses with whole-body wobble. All adults and supporting adults share the bold new geometric design language.
ROW 1 TEACHER: tall slim adult woman with a long soft-rectangular warm brown face, strong nose and brows, asymmetrical dark burgundy wedge bob, magenta blazer and navy trousers. Supports a small open book with her LEFT hand in all columns, next to a minimal blank teal board. Her RIGHT connected arm points to the board: low, chest level, higher, then open explanatory palm.
ROW 2 CHEF: broad short barrel-bodied adult man with square peach face, large nose, navy moustache and thick brows, white angular chef hat, cream jacket, magenta neckerchief, navy trousers. A simple teal pot rests on a tiny orange counter. His connected RIGHT hand grips a spoon continuously while his forearm follows four distinct stirring positions. LEFT hand on pot handle throughout.
ROW 3 DOCTOR: tall slim middle-aged man with dark brown angular rectangular face, black geometric hair and brows, cream coat with teal stethoscope, navy trousers. Beside him sits a fully NEW adult woman patient, broad head with angular orange bob, magenta shirt and teal trousers on one simple stool. Doctor's LEFT hand supports the patient's outstretched wrist continuously; RIGHT hand checks the wrist, indicates pulse, opens in reassurance, returns. Adult patient fully visible, two connected arms, face unobstructed.
ROW 4 OFFICE WORKER: broad pear-shaped adult woman with an angular honey-colored face, navy rectangular glasses, orange side-part geometric hair, teal blouse. Seated at a minimal orange desk and teal laptop. Four distinct connected arm phases: both hands keyboard, right hand lifted thinking, right index points screen, hands return typing. Entire seated figure and chair contained.
ROW 5 RECEPTIONIST: slim adult woman with long peach rectangular face, oversized triangular nose, strong brows and dark purple asymmetric short hair, magenta tunic. Behind a small plain teal desk with a yellow bell. LEFT hand rests desk continuously; RIGHT connected arm makes four distinct greeting gestures: low open palm, bent at chest, raised sideways, fingers touching bell. Face unchanged.
ROW 6 SALESCLERK: tall lanky adult man with olive tan angular head, large nose, thick brows and a bold black side-part quiff, teal apron over cream shirt, navy trousers. Two folded shirts on a tiny orange counter. Four connected two-hand folding phases of a single magenta shirt: gripping lower edges, lifting at chest, bringing edges inward, laying down folded. Cloth always touches both hands. No extra limbs.
ROW 7 TAXI DRIVER: broad muscular adult woman with dark brown soft-square head, bold nose, small white eyes, navy short hair under a navy cap, yellow vest, cream shirt, navy trousers. Beside a small front-view yellow taxi. Her LEFT hand stays on hip. RIGHT connected arm makes four welcoming gestures toward the taxi: bent low, open palm chest height, pointing to car, broad open palm. Taxi remains fixed.
Remember: adult rectangular features, graphic silhouette variety, strict solid fills and actual transparent background.
